source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.9.1, printed page 131 (Figure 6.5).

blocks.text: Jab ionic compounds pani mein ghulte hain to woh ions mein toot jate hain, aur phir pani ke molecules in ions ko gher lete hain.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.text: Woh process jis mein pani ke molecules solute ke ions ko gher lete hain aur un se interact karte hain, hydration kehlata hai.
Pani ke molecules aur ions ke darmiyan jo forces banti hain unhen ion-dipole forces kehte hain (Figure 6.5). Is wajah se aqueous solution ke sab ions hydrated kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf peele cations (+) aur hare anions (-) ki ionic lattice. Oopar pani ka ek molecule (surkh O aur do white H) apne O end se ek cation ki taraf khincha hai, O par delta- aur H par delta+; neeche pani ka molecule apne H ends se ek anion ki taraf khincha hai, H par delta+ aur O par delta-. Khamdar arrow lattice se ek hydrated cation tak jate hain jise chhe pani ke molecules O end andar kiye ghere hain, aur ek hydrated anion tak jise chhe molecules H end andar kiye ghere hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.5: Hydration ke process se ionic compound ka ghulna (kitab ki Figure 6.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Ion-dipole force ki wajah se attraction ki energy ko enthalpy of hydration kehte hain. Kitab is ki definition yun karti hai:

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pani ke molecule ka oxygen wala end thoda negative (δ⁻) aur hydrogen wale ends thode positive (δ⁺) hain. Positive ion (Na⁺) ki taraf oxygen ki direction (rukh) hoti hai, aur negative ion (Cl⁻) ki taraf hydrogen ka. Har ion ke gird pani ka ek circle (ghera) ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Enthalpy of hydration
blocks.text: Woh enthalpy change jo tab hoti hai jab gaseous ions ka ek mole zyada pani mein ghul kar standard conditions par infinitely dilute solution banaye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki yeh definition asal mein enthalpy of solution ki hai. Enthalpy of hydration woh enthalpy change hai jab gaseous ions (gas wale ions) ka ek mole zyada pani mein ghul kar standard conditions par infinitely dilute solution banaye, maslan Na⁺(g) + aq → Na⁺(aq). Yeh hamesha negative (exothermic) hoti hai.
Is ka symbol ΔHhyd hai. Yeh energy hamesha bahar nikalti hai, kyun ke is mein ion-dipole bond banta hai.
